headline: Tuesday: a 5-game NBA night and a huge college basketball slate (Illinois @ Duke, Michigan State @ Tennessee).

record.label: Last board (Mon 11/16)
record.note: Bad night. The Chargers beat the Ravens 23-20, so 43 points sank the Under even with four sources agreeing (counted twice). The Cavaliers beat the Bulls by 11 (+9.5 missed), and Tulsa won by only 3 (-6.5 missed). Wins: Prairie View +33.5 (lost by 27) and Herbert under 203.5 passing yards (129). The board is down about 11.1 units since Oct 2.

notes: The board is down about 11 units over seven weeks, so these picks have been losing money. If you keep betting them, use the smallest stake you're comfortable with, or sit some days out.
No bet is a lock. 'Confidence' runs 1–5, and nothing on this board is above a 3.
Odds move. Skip any pick whose price is past the 'playable to' number in its reasoning.
Bet only what you can afford to lose. Help: 1-800-GAMBLER.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: Monday this tab went 0-1 (the Under). Today: Dimers and Covers both pick New York in Toronto, where Kawhi Leonard is out.

straight.reasoning: Two sources agree. Dimers' model gives the Knicks a 52% chance to cover at a plus price, and Covers takes New York to win: the Knicks have beaten Toronto 14 straight times and the Raptors are without Kawhi Leonard. Playable to -4; skip at -4.5.

sections.label: NBA
sections.slate: Five games tonight. Sources split on Pistons-Spurs and Blazers-Timberwolves, so those are skipped.

straight.reasoning: Dimers and Covers both pick New York, and Kawhi Leonard is out. Playable to -4.

Dimers gives Charlotte a 53.8% chance to cover, and Covers takes the Hornets to win outright: Charlotte stayed in LA after Sunday's game while the Lakers are coming home from a four-game road trip, and the Hornets are second in the league in rebounding. Kept to a quarter unit because Covers' pick is a long-shot moneyline. Playable to +7.

Dimers picks the Clippers to cover, and Covers takes them to win: Utah is missing three frontcourt players, including Jaren Jackson Jr. and Lauri Markkanen, and has the league's worst shot quality. Dimers' edge is small, so it's a quarter unit. Playable to -7.

sections.label: College Hoops
sections.slate: Big Tuesday: Illinois @ Duke, Michigan State @ Tennessee, Indiana @ Arkansas, Villanova @ Pitt. Each pick comes from one source, so they're quarter units.

straight.reasoning: RotoWire: Tennessee's 3-0 start came against an easy schedule, and its defensive rebounding is weak. Michigan State is near the top of the country in offensive rebounding, free-throw rate and blocks, and has the best player on the floor in Jeremy Fears. Playable to -3.5.

RotoWire: Illinois has one of the most efficient offenses in the country and lost by only 6 at Texas Tech. Duke's win over Michigan State wasn't close for most of the game, but 7.5 points against a top offense is a lot. Price is an estimate; playable to +7.

FanDuel Research: Villanova has the better offense (1.163 points per possession to Pitt's 1.124), a much better effective field goal percentage, and a 36.6% offensive rebound rate. It has won three straight. Playable to -130.
